question: Rachin travels a distance at 60 km/hr for 2 hours and 80 km at 40 km/hr. Find the average speed of Rachin (in km/hr).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

D₁ = 60 × 2 = 120 km

T₂ = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

Total Distance = 120 + 80 = 200 km

Total Time = 2 + 2 = 4 hours

Average speed = 200 ÷ 4 = 50 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed in part 1 (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Time in part 1 (T₁) = 2 hours

Distance in part 2 (D₂) = 80 km

Speed in part 2 (S₂) = 40 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 
• 
 
 
 
 120 km
 S1 = 60 km/hr
 T1 = 2 hr
 80 km
 S2 = 40 km/hr
 T2 = 2 hr
 

 Total Distance = 200 km, Total Time = 4 hr
 Average Speed = 200 ÷ 4 = 50 km/hr

**Calculations:**

⇒ D₁ = S₁ × T₁ = 60 × 2 = 120 km

⇒ T₂ = D₂ ÷ S₂ = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

⇒ Total Distance = D₁ + D₂ = 120 + 80 = 200 km

⇒ Total Time = T₁ + T₂ = 2 + 2 = 4 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 200 ÷ 4 = 50 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (General Formula)

The average speed of a journey is defined as the Total Distance traveled divided by the Total Time taken.

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If a person travels equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is given by (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed (Equal Times)

If a person travels for equal durations of time at speeds x and y, the average speed is (x + y) ÷ 2.
